name: Machine Gun 10k (code)
description: The M-1000 Maxigun's backpack holds 10,000 rounds. The mod SDK's reference example: a definition block sets the backpack's capacity, starting ammo and resupply by name, an event widens the engine's deposit_value network field from 10 to 14 bits (which no Lua mod can), and the mod's log says what it did. Source in src/.
